deploy.title: Deploy here
deploy.body: Update this application where it runs, with the steps it keeps for a deploy.
deploy.how: A deploy checks the application, takes a safety backup and records its .env file, runs these steps in order, then checks the application again. It stops at the first step that fails.
deploy.rehearsalHow: A rehearsal needs no password and changes nothing. Each step only reads: git fetch --dry-run, compose config, migrate --plan, collectstatic --dry-run.
deploy.stepsInvalid: A saved step no longer fits this application. Edit the steps, then deploy.

empty.title: No deploy steps yet
empty.body: Choose what a deploy runs here, in order: pull the code, pull or build images, restart, migrate, collect static files.

run.passwordHint: Needed to deploy for real. A rehearsal needs no password.

progress.title: Deploying
progress.rehearsed: The rehearsal finished. Nothing was changed.

revert.title: Restore the safety backup
revert.body: Restore the backup taken before this deploy began. It puts the data back only: the code and the images stay as the deploy left them.

run.passwordHint: Needed to restore for real. A rehearsal needs no password.

progress.title: Restoring
progress.done: The data is back as it was before the deploy. The code and the images are as the deploy left them.
progress.rehearsed: The restore rehearsal finished. Nothing was changed.

editor.label: Deploy steps
editor.none: No steps. Saving leaves nothing to deploy.
editor.remoteHint: Optional, such as origin. Name a branch with it.
editor.branchHint: Optional, such as main. Left empty, the current branch's upstream is pulled.
editor.servicesHint: Left empty, every service. Press Enter after each name.
editor.unitHint: A unit that ends in .service, such as app.service.
editor.requirementsHint: A file inside the application's folder, such as requirements.txt.
editor.full: A deploy runs at most twelve steps.
editor.folderMissing: Git pull and pip install need the application's folder. Set it in the application's settings.

prompt.title: Save the deploy steps
prompt.body: Enter your password to save the deploy steps of this application.

problems.unknown_step: Choose one of the steps offered here.
problems.unknown_option: This step takes no such option.
problems.invalid_name: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores and slashes.
problems.branch_required: Name the branch together with its remote.
problems.invalid_service: Name Compose services with letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
problems.invalid_unit: Name a user unit that ends in .service.
problems.invalid_requirements: Name a file inside the application's folder, such as requirements.txt.
problems.too_many_steps: A deploy runs at most twelve steps.
problems.project_dir_required: This step runs in the application's folder. Set the folder first.
problems.compose_required: This step runs only for an application in a Compose service.
problems.container_required: This step restarts a container or a Compose service, and this application runs on the server itself.
problems.host_required: This step runs only for an application on the server itself.

move.title: Move to another application
move.body: Move this project onto another application, on this server or another one. This application is left as it is.
move.needsCode: The new application must already run the project's code with the same environment: its virtual environment or image, django-dbs and the same settings.
move.how: When this application answers, a fresh backup of it is taken now and restored. The new application's .env file and data are recorded first; then the .env file is pushed, the migrations run, the backup is restored and the new application is checked.
move.targetRequired: Choose the application to move to.
move.backup: Backup to restore if this application does not answer
move.backupHint: The newest is chosen. When this application answers, a fresh backup is restored instead.
move.noBackup: None: stop if this application does not answer
move.flush: Replace the data of the new application instead of merging

run.passwordHint: Needed to move for real. A rehearsal needs no password.

progress.title: Moving
progress.rehearsed: The rehearsal finished. Nothing was changed on either application.
progress.chosenBackup: This application did not answer, so the chosen backup was restored.
progress.sourceSilent: This application did not answer. A move now would restore the chosen backup instead of a fresh one.

steps.safety_backup: Back up the new application's data

revert.title: Revert the new application
revert.body: Push the new application's recorded .env file back and restore the backup of its data taken before the move, replacing what the move left there.

run.passwordHint: Needed to revert for real. A rehearsal needs no password.

progress.title: Reverting
progress.done: The new application is back as it was before the move.
progress.rehearsed: The revert rehearsal finished. Nothing was changed.

errors.same_application: Choose an application other than this one.
errors.target_not_ready: django-dbs is not installed, or the project is not ready, in the application being changed.
errors.source_unreachable: This application did not answer and no backup of it was chosen.
errors.no_backup_to_rehearse: There is no backup of this application here for the rehearsal to restore. Take one first.
errors.move_not_revertable: Only a move or a deploy that stopped after it changed the application can be reverted.
errors.no_deploy_steps: This application has no deploy steps yet. Choose them first.
